## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her classmates adjust to life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) as exams approach, balancing academic rivalry and friendships. Meanwhile, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) continues visiting [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and maintains a positive perspective on her studies and upcoming examinations.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. > During lunch, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks down and smashes Miss Pembroke's platter, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic. After the guests leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a letter from [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stating their visit is canceled. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) sit together outdoors, discussing the day's mishaps, life's disappointments, and local rumors as Hugh approaches.
